lines.en: I head to the park first thing in the morning to find Otoha relaxing on a bench and waiting for things to warm up a bit.
lines.zh: 一大早我就去了公园，发现 Otoha 正坐在长椅上休息，等着天气暖和一点。

lines.en: She invites me to sit next to her and kill time while the rest of Kumon-mi gets out of bed and starts heading wherever it is that all of them need to head over the weekend.
lines.zh: 她邀我坐到她旁边打发时间，等 Kumon-mi 的其他人起床、开始涌向她们这个周末该去的各个地方。

lines.en: Despite not having the {i}best{/i} foot traffic in the area, this park is still located in a relatively convenient place between the[school] and several popular locations.
lines.zh: 尽管这一带的人流量算不上{i}最好{/i}，这座公园的位置还是相当便利，正好夹在[school]和几处热门地点之间。

lines.en: They show up, watch for several seconds as she starts playing, and then head on their way without so much as even making eye contact with either one of us.
lines.zh: 他们来了，看上几秒她开始弹琴，然后就各走各的路，连跟我俩任何一个对上眼都没有。

lines.en: Feeling that I may be...detracting from her only source of income, I decide that it's probably best if I just let Otoha do this on her own.
lines.zh: 觉得自己可能……在分流她唯一的收入来源，我决定最好还是让 Otoha 一个人待着做这件事。

lines.en: She doesn't put up much of a fight because...well, why {i}would{/i} she want me sitting around while she tries to make money?
lines.zh: 她没怎么抗争，因为……嗯，她想赚钱的时候，为什么{i}会{/i}希望我坐在旁边？

lines.en: I reach into my pocket, ready to grab a tip to toss into her guitar case.
lines.zh: 我伸手进口袋，准备掏点小费扔进她的琴盒。

lines.en: Her eyes light up...but then immediately go dark as soon as my hand exits my pocket with absolutely nothing in it.
lines.zh: 她的眼睛亮了起来……可当我的手从口袋里出来、里面空空如也的时候，那光立刻又暗了下去。

lines.en: I should probably start bringing cash with me if I'm going to keep visiting her while she's performing...
lines.zh: 要是以后还要在她表演的时候去看她，我大概该开始随身带点现金了……
